scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,admin -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w admin && npm run build -w api
scripts.cf:secrets: grep -v '^CLOUDFLARE_' .dev.vars | grep -v '^#' | grep -v '^$' > .dev.vars.worker && wrangler secret bulk .dev.vars.worker && rm .dev.vars.worker
